retrievalProfile.description: A classic 1960s record sleeve layout featuring a full-body studio portrait on the left and heavy, stacked sans-serif typography on the right.

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, white-background composition divided vertically: the left side contains a full-body, dynamic studio portrait of a performer, while the right side features large, bold, stacked sans-serif text in contrasting colors, followed by a smaller tracklist.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left balances heavy typography on the right
High-contrast color blocks in text create visual hierarchy
Thin border frame contains the entire composition
Negative space provides a clean, professional studio feel
coreInvariants: Off-white or stark white studio background
Thin rectangular border enclosing the main content

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subject positioned in the left third, scaled to nearly the full height of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold primary title text in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the large title, then down through the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space around the subject and between text blocks to maintain clarity.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple and burnt orange for primary text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for secondary text and subject's clothing
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with medium-saturation, high-contrast text colors.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to 3-4 primary colors plus black and white

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard bold grotesque forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque weight and feel
Provides the necessary vertical presence and density

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio portrait of a person in 1960s attire against a solid white background, positioned on the left side of the frame. Include a thin black rectangular border around the entire composition.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay bold, uppercase sans-serif text on the right side. Use a purple color for the top two lines and a burnt orange for the next three lines. Below this, add a list of text in small black uppercase sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the subject on the left?
Is the text stacked on the right?
Are the colors for the title distinct (e.g., Purple/Orange)?
Is there a thin border around the image?

postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of text on the right
Ensure the subject does not overlap the text
Verify the border is consistent and thin
Confirm the color palette is limited and retro
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait (Left) + Stacked Bold Sans-Serif (Right) + Thin Border Frame = Mid-Century Album Aesthetic
